summary: Wrote preregistration_hypotheses.md and program.py for pack s04, task (a). Diagnosis indicates s04 is likely an uncorrupted (healthy) control model (C0 CER 0.0727, smooth parent-to-child drift across all conv, BiLSTM, and aligned output tensors); program.py runs a granular parent-vs-subject slice/row/bias scan and tests H1 (outlier row repair if detected), H2 (CTC blank bias reduction), H3 (space character bias calibration), and H4 (gentle L_16 parent interpolation), keeping an edit only if collapsed lines do not increase, CER improves by >= 0.0005, and the harness's 95% paired bootstrap CI rule passes.
